A grieving father is demanding answers after his 22-year-old daughter, Logan Federico, was fatally shot while visiting friends in South Carolina.

Stephen Federico believes his daughter was killed because she could identify the suspect, not because of money or a debit card.

CANADA LOSES 68,300 JOBS IN SEPTEMBER, FAR WORSE THAN EXPECTED

Canada's economy shed 68,300 jobs in September, sharply missing forecasts for a 9,200 gain.

The unemployment rate rose to 6.5%, while both full-time and part-time employment declined.

The services sector lost 52,300 jobs, with labor force participation falling to 64.8%.

Meanwhile, annual wage growth accelerated to 2.3%, complicating the inflation outlook.
